Number to Words Converter

Convert any whole number up to 9 quadrillion into English words. Perfect for writing checks, invoices and legal documents.

–
In words
–
Digits

Converts whole numbers from −9,007,199,254,740,991 to +9,007,199,254,740,991.

📖 How to use

  1. Type any whole number (decimals are not supported).
  2. The English words appear instantly.
  3. Copy the result for your check, invoice or document.
  4. Negative numbers are converted with a “minus” prefix.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How large a number can it convert?

Any whole number from −9,007,199,254,740,991 to +9,007,199,254,740,991 (JavaScript's maximum safe integer), covering up to quadrillions.

Does it handle negative numbers?

Yes — a negative input is prefixed with “minus”, e.g. −42 becomes “minus forty-two”.

Is this the style used on checks?

It produces standard US-style words without “and” (one hundred twenty-three). For checks, banks usually accept this; add “and 00/100” for cents yourself.
